old-layout check at gate and push; ledger exempt line by line as of the commit that added the check; selftest covers old and new rows
decisions.why: FR-007 with FR-004's 'rows written before this feature'. Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE is resolved: a row written after the check is held like any live line. Implementation read (scripts/check-old-layout.py old_ledger_lines: oldest --diff-filter=A commit of the check) matches the plan.

decisions.summary: carry moves old-dir artifacts to the root; colliding caches deleted (reason recorded), other colliding files kept as <name>.pre-329 (numbered if taken); old directory always removed
decisions.why: FR-008 verbatim: carry, or invalidate a cache with the reason recorded, and leave no old directory. The numbered suffix closes round 2's note: no collision can leave the old directory behind, and nothing non-cache is deleted.

decisions.summary: merge.directoryRenames=true in the global git config (setup-dev-env.sh, applied once in the running container) and passed by sync_in; the mirror's clone-sync hook runs _layout_carry.sh after a clone's sync-in; scratch-clone test
decisions.why: FR-009 and FR-008. R5 measures why (2026-10-07, scratch repos, git 2.53 ort): default config stops on a file added under the renamed directory; a not-yet-synced clone runs its own pre-move script, so the flag and the carry must reach it from outside that script. A mechanism serving the two FRs, not a narrowing; the global setting's reach beyond this repository is a design note, not a fidelity finding.
